column2: First basket = P(team scores first) x player share. P(team scores first) comes from the two main jumpers' tip-win rates (log5) and the 25-26 league rate that the tip winner scores first (64%). Share = his share of his team's first FGs as a starter, shrunk toward 1 in 5. Fair odds are the break-even price; only bet when the book pays more. Points / threes = highest line with a 70%+ blended hit rate as a starter. Recheck starting lineups 30 minutes before tip. Opening night 10/20: the value longer shots hit (Collins +1000, Vassell +800) while the book favorites (Wembanyama, Embiid) missed, and Queta did not start. Lean to role starters priced well past fair, skip favorites priced under fair, and only bet a player once his start is confirmed.
